title: Free Alternatives to Slack 2026: 8 Tools Tested
description: Slack free tier limits message history to 90 days. Here are 8 free alternatives that offer unlimited history, better free tiers, or similar features without the monthly cost.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.description: Included with Microsoft 365. Unlimited chat, 100-participant meetings, and Office document collaboration. Best for companies already in the Microsoft ecosystem.

tools.name: Discord
tools.description: Unlimited message history, voice channels, and screen sharing. Originally for gaming, now widely used by startups and open-source communities. Free for unlimited users.

tools.name: Google Chat
tools.description: Included with Google Workspace. Threaded conversations, file sharing, and Google Meet integration. Free for personal Google accounts with limited features.

tools.name: Element (Matrix)
tools.description: Open-source, end-to-end encrypted messaging built on the Matrix protocol. Self-hostable for complete data control. Free for unlimited users.

tools.name: Rocket.Chat
tools.description: Open-source team communication with self-hosting option. Unlimited channels, file sharing, and video calls. Free community edition available.

tools.name: Zulip
tools.description: Threaded conversations organized by topic. Unique approach to channel organization. Free tier includes 10,000 messages of history.

tools.name: Mattermost
tools.description: Open-source Slack alternative with self-hosting. Integrates with Git, Jira, and CI/CD tools. Free community edition for unlimited users.

tools.name: Flock
tools.description: Team messaging with built-in to-dos, reminders, and notes. Free tier limited to 10 users and 10,000 messages. Simple and focused.

verdict: Microsoft Teams is the best free Slack alternative for most businesses. Discord works well for small teams who want voice channels. Google Chat is ideal if you already use Google Workspace. For privacy-focused teams, Element and Rocket.Chat offer self-hosting options. Zulip unique topic-based threading is great for teams with many concurrent discussions.

faqs.question: What is the best free alternative to Slack?
faqs.answer: Microsoft Teams is the best free alternative. It offers unlimited chat, 100-participant meetings, and Office document collaboration. If you already use Microsoft 365, Teams is included at no extra cost.

faqs.question: Does Slack free tier have unlimited messages?
faqs.answer: No, Slack free tier limits message history to 90 days. After 90 days, old messages are archived and not searchable. Paid plans start at 7.25 dollars/user/mo for unlimited history.

faqs.question: Is Discord good for business communication?
faqs.answer: Yes, Discord works well for small teams. It offers unlimited message history, voice channels, and screen sharing for free. However, it lacks enterprise features like compliance, SSO, and admin controls.

faqs.question: Can I self-host a Slack alternative?
faqs.answer: Yes, Mattermost, Rocket.Chat, and Element all offer self-hosting options. Self-hosting gives you complete data control but requires server management. Free community editions are available for all three.

faqs.question: Which alternative has the best threading?
faqs.answer: Zulip has the best threading model. Every conversation is organized by topic, making it easy to follow multiple discussions. Slack threads are nested under messages, which can get cluttered in busy channels.

author: Emily Nakamura
